name: Jarvis
author: VGS
description: Owns the Jarvis child daemon and shows its state in the bar, where a click toggles privacy mute. This service does not capture audio or connect to a provider.

mode.label: Talk mode
mode.description: Hold commits on release. Toggle keeps a conversation open. Audio engines are not configured yet.

speaker.label: Speaker
speaker.description: Half duplex: Jarvis closes its microphone while speech plays. Talk interrupts speech.

brain.label: Brain account
brain.description: Found accounts are not proof of inference access. An unavailable saved selection is retained.

taskTerminal.label: Task terminal
taskTerminal.description: Where a coding task's terminal opens. Auto uses tmux when it is installed, which runs several tasks at once; the floating terminal shows one task at a time.

requirements.purpose: Runs the Jarvis daemon, which requires Node 22 or later
Stores and reads provider keys in the desktop keyring
Checks key presence without reading secrets or unlocking the keyring
Draws headers and choices in Jarvis terminal flows
Serializes coding-task record writers
Confines shell commands; shell tools require a successful kernel sandbox probe
Lets Jarvis read clipboard text, except a copy a password manager marks as secret
Lets Jarvis copy text to the clipboard
Lets Jarvis play, pause and skip media
Lets Jarvis set and mute the speaker volume
Lets Jarvis show a desktop notification
Captures microphone PCM through a leased child
Plays speech PCM through a leased child
Reads available microphones and speakers without changing defaults
Kills audio children when their parent ends
Owns audio process namespaces and isolates the local voice probe
Owns audio pipe leases and verifies the private local voice runtime
Installs the locked local voice runtime when setup is selected
Downloads pinned local voice models when setup is selected
Verifies CUDA execution only when a CUDA local tier is selected
Finds local model-server ports without making an inference request
Opens a file or web link for Jarvis with its default application
Checks Claude Code login hints in each account directory
Checks Codex login hints in each account directory
Runs several coding tasks at once, each in its own session

daemon.label: Daemon
daemon.hint: The service starts no audio capture.

keys.label: Provider keys
keys.hint: Use Add key below. This check never reads a key or unlocks the keyring.

audio.label: Audio
audio.hint: Half duplex closes capture during speech. Echo cancellation is not supported.

localRuntime.label: Local voice
localRuntime.hint: Setup downloads models and verifies the selected runtime without opening audio devices.

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.hint: Login hints are not inference proof. Accounts offers explicit API or local verification, which may cost money.

tasks.label: Coding tasks
tasks.hint: Coding tasks whose agent is starting or running.
